'''PDA6''' was a [[PD-series protocol droid|PD Lurrian protocol droid]], a series of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] designed by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. PDA6 was stationed aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] of an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] botanist named [[Zorneth|Master Zorneth]]. PDA6 partnered with fellow protocol [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on a mission to bring down the [[Force field/Legends|force field]] which protected the fortress of [[Craw]], the dictator of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]].
